quotes.text: So you have had an opportunity—a couple [...] have a lack of data. We just haven't done the mapping. We haven't done the review, the analysis, and so, we know that with AI, your output is just as good as your input. [...] how can we utilize the benefits of AI in government processes for good while ensuring that, perhaps, some states, some areas, like Alaska, where data is just not complete, that they are not actually disadvantaged? Have you given thought to that?

there is a lot of good that we can gain from AI, and as scary, I think, as it is in so many different areas, I think it's important not to lose sight that when utilized correctly, it can truly be transformational.
The concerns here that AI systems can be tricked into providing instruction for causing physical harm. We have talked about that. We need to address it.

Right now, America is in an artificial intelligence (AI) arms race with China. [...] And keeping our energy production for electricity, our baseload power production open, will help us win this contest while driving down electricity costs for American families.
